description.en: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for sending text, images, and files as native steering messages, with read/pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue into the main composer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加独立插话栏，支持文字、图片和普通文件；显示读取状态，可取消未读取插话，并在任务结束时把未发送草稿搬进主输入框。
